additional_info.subject: RE: ID0398441-DC/Si-D/DK-[ MP / R5 170001905 ] Main breaker fault CRM:00641000954
additional_info.body:
Dear Martin Koch,
Hope you are doing well,
As per the reported issue, we have checked the charger on SCB and identified a failure with the Main Breaker (QA1) not closing. Therefore, a site intervention is required.
Checklist for Troubleshooting
Wiring and Power Supply
Inspect all wiring and verify the presence of 230V AC power supply from QA29 & QA28 to the MA1 terminal.
Contactor Checks
Inspect the coils and auxiliary contactors QA28 and QA29, which control the ON/OFF operation of the motor charging operator.
Input and Output Status
Check the status of:
Input:
DI12
(used for status monitoring).
Output commands:
DQ9 & DQ10
(used for sending commands to the breaker).
Manual MCCB Operation
Plan to manually close the MCCB by applying 24V manually to QA29.
MA1 Terminal Verification
Verify if the MA1 terminal is not closing even after receiving a positive latch.
Check if there are no lights on the ACT indicator.
Component Replacement Plan
If the issue persists:
Replace MA1
and restart the charger.
If the problem still exists,
replace QA1 breaker
.
Please refer to the attached
schematic
and
knowledge article
for detailed guidance on troubleshooting the issue.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SID_HW_Braeker,QA1_Mainbreaker QA1 error - Dynamics 365
Please carry the following spare parts in case replacements are needed during the site intervention.
QA1-: 3VA1463-6EF42-0AA0
MA1-: 3VA9467-0HA20
Contactor-:  QA28/QA29
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Abhinav Malokar
